description: Hand-curated sample of well-known papers across transformers/LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge graphs, graph neural networks and graph-based fraud detection. Used to demo ResearchGraph without network access.

provenance.curation: Titles, first-public-release years, arXiv identifiers, venues and author lists were entered by hand from well-known bibliographic knowledge.
provenance.year: Year of first public release (arXiv or venue, whichever came first).
provenance.authors: Author names map to a stable key (slug of the name). The same name across papers is asserted to be the same person; an explicit {name, key} object disambiguates different people who share a name. authors_complete=false marks papers whose author list was deliberately truncated.
provenance.description: One-sentence curated descriptions written for this dataset. They are NOT the papers' abstracts.
provenance.citations: 'cites' lists a curated, high-confidence SUBSET of each paper's references among papers in this seed. It is not a complete reference list and was not machine-extracted.
provenance.not_included: No citation counts, abstracts or DOIs are included. Run OpenAlex ingestion to add authoritative metadata; entity resolution merges it into these records by arXiv ID and title/year/author matching.

papers.title: The PageRank Citation Ranking: Bringing Order to the Web
papers.description: Ranks web pages by the stationary distribution of a random surfer over the hyperlink graph, so a page is important if important pages link to it.

papers.title: Long Short-Term Memory
papers.description: Introduces a gated recurrent cell with a constant error carousel that lets recurrent networks learn long-range dependencies.

papers.title: Fast unfolding of communities in large networks
papers.description: A greedy, hierarchical modularity-optimisation heuristic (the Louvain method) that scales community detection to very large networks.

papers.title: From Louvain to Leiden: guaranteeing well-connected communities
papers.description: Shows that Louvain can produce badly connected communities and proposes the Leiden algorithm, which guarantees connected communities and converges faster.

papers.title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
papers.description: Proposes the CBOW and skip-gram log-linear models for learning word vectors efficiently from large corpora.

papers.title: GloVe: Global Vectors for Word Representation
papers.description: Learns word vectors by factorising global word co-occurrence statistics with a weighted least-squares objective.

papers.title: Sequence to Sequence Learning with Neural Networks
papers.description: Uses a multilayer LSTM encoder and decoder to map input sequences to output sequences, applied to machine translation.

papers.title: Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder-Decoder for Statistical Machine Translation
papers.description: Introduces the RNN encoder-decoder for scoring phrase pairs and the gated recurrent unit (GRU).

papers.title: Neural Machine Translation by Jointly Learning to Align and Translate
papers.description: Adds a learned soft alignment (attention) over encoder states so the decoder is not limited by a single fixed-length context vector.

papers.title: Effective Approaches to Attention-based Neural Machine Translation
papers.description: Compares global and local attention variants for neural machine translation.

papers.title: Adam: A Method for Stochastic Optimization
papers.description: An optimiser that adapts per-parameter step sizes from estimates of the first and second moments of the gradients.

papers.title: Dropout: A Simple Way to Prevent Neural Networks from Overfitting
papers.description: Randomly drops units during training to reduce co-adaptation and overfitting.

papers.title: Batch Normalization: Accelerating Deep Network Training by Reducing Internal Covariate Shift
papers.description: Normalises layer inputs using mini-batch statistics, allowing higher learning rates and faster training.

papers.title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
papers.description: Introduces residual (skip) connections that make very deep convolutional networks trainable.

papers.title: Layer Normalization
papers.description: Normalises across the features of a single example rather than across a batch, which suits recurrent networks.

papers.title: Attention Is All You Need
papers.description: Introduces the Transformer, an encoder-decoder architecture based entirely on multi-head self-attention, without recurrence or convolution.

papers.title: Deep contextualized word representations
papers.description: Derives contextual word representations from the internal states of a deep bidirectional LSTM language model (ELMo).

papers.title: Improving Language Understanding by Generative Pre-Training
papers.description: Pretrains a Transformer decoder as a language model on unlabeled text, then fine-tunes it on downstream tasks.

papers.title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding
papers.description: Pretrains a bidirectional Transformer encoder with masked language modelling and next-sentence prediction, then fine-tunes it per task.

papers.title: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners
papers.description: Scales up Transformer language modelling (GPT-2) and studies zero-shot task performance without fine-tuning.

papers.title: Transformer-XL: Attentive Language Models beyond a Fixed-Length Context
papers.description: Adds segment-level recurrence and relative positional encodings so Transformer language models can use longer context.

papers.title: Generating Long Sequences with Sparse Transformers
papers.description: Uses factorised sparse attention patterns to reduce attention cost for long sequences.

papers.title: XLNet: Generalized Autoregressive Pretraining for Language Understanding
papers.description: Pretrains with a permutation-based autoregressive objective, building on Transformer-XL.

papers.title: RoBERTa: A Robustly Optimized BERT Pretraining Approach
papers.description: Re-examines BERT pretraining choices (data, batch size, training length, objectives) and shows a better-tuned recipe.

papers.title: SciBERT: A Pretrained Language Model for Scientific Text
papers.description: Pretrains BERT on a large corpus of scientific papers and evaluates it on scientific NLP tasks.

papers.title: Sentence-BERT: Sentence Embeddings using Siamese BERT-Networks
papers.description: Fine-tunes BERT in a siamese setup to produce sentence embeddings that can be compared with cosine similarity.

papers.title: BART: Denoising Sequence-to-Sequence Pre-training for Natural Language Generation, Translation, and Comprehension
papers.description: Pretrains a sequence-to-sequence Transformer by reconstructing text corrupted with noising functions.

papers.title: Exploring the Limits of Transfer Learning with a Unified Text-to-Text Transformer
papers.description: Casts every NLP task as text-to-text and systematically compares pretraining objectives, architectures and data (T5).

papers.title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
papers.description: Empirically relates language-model loss to model size, dataset size and compute via power laws.

papers.title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
papers.description: Trains a 175B-parameter autoregressive language model (GPT-3) and studies few-shot learning from in-context examples.

papers.title: Longformer: The Long-Document Transformer
papers.description: Combines local windowed attention with task-specific global attention so attention cost grows linearly with length.

papers.title: Reformer: The Efficient Transformer
papers.description: Reduces Transformer memory and compute with locality-sensitive-hashing attention and reversible residual layers.

papers.title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
papers.description: Applies a standard Transformer encoder directly to sequences of image patches (ViT).

papers.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
papers.description: Freezes pretrained weights and trains low-rank update matrices, greatly reducing the number of trainable parameters for adaptation.

papers.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
papers.description: Fine-tunes GPT-3 with supervised demonstrations and reinforcement learning from human feedback (InstructGPT).

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.description: Shows that few-shot prompts containing intermediate reasoning steps improve large language models on multi-step reasoning tasks.

papers.title: Training Compute-Optimal Large Language Models
papers.description: Revisits scaling laws and argues model size and training tokens should grow in equal proportion for a fixed compute budget (Chinchilla).

papers.title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways
papers.description: Trains a 540B-parameter dense Transformer language model with the Pathways system and evaluates few-shot performance.

papers.title: FlashAttention: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Attention with IO-Awareness
papers.description: Computes exact attention with tiling to minimise GPU memory reads and writes, speeding up training on long sequences.

papers.title: LLaMA: Open and Efficient Foundation Language Models
papers.description: Releases a family of foundation language models trained only on publicly available data.

papers.title: GPT-4 Technical Report
papers.description: Technical report describing GPT-4, a large multimodal model, and its evaluation.

papers.title: Llama 2: Open Foundation and Fine-Tuned Chat Models
papers.description: Releases pretrained and chat-tuned open language models and describes their fine-tuning and safety process.

papers.title: The Probabilistic Relevance Framework: BM25 and Beyond
papers.description: Surveys the probabilistic relevance framework underlying BM25 and its extensions.

papers.title: Efficient and robust approximate nearest neighbor search using Hierarchical Navigable Small World graphs
papers.description: Builds a multi-layer proximity graph for approximate nearest-neighbour search with logarithmic search complexity.

papers.title: Billion-scale similarity search with GPUs
papers.description: Describes GPU algorithms for exact and compressed-domain similarity search, released as the Faiss library.

papers.title: Language Models as Knowledge Bases?
papers.description: Probes pretrained language models with cloze statements to measure how much relational factual knowledge they contain (LAMA).

papers.title: REALM: Retrieval-Augmented Language Model Pre-Training
papers.description: Pretrains a language model jointly with a learned retriever over a document corpus, backpropagating through retrieval.

papers.title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering
papers.description: Trains a BERT dual encoder on question-passage pairs and shows dense retrieval can outperform BM25 for open-domain QA.

papers.title: ColBERT: Efficient and Effective Passage Search via Contextualized Late Interaction over BERT
papers.description: Encodes queries and passages independently with BERT and scores them with token-level late interaction for efficient retrieval.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
papers.description: Combines a pretrained seq2seq generator with a dense retriever over Wikipedia, treating retrieved passages as a latent variable (RAG).

papers.title: Leveraging Passage Retrieval with Generative Models for Open Domain Question Answering
papers.description: Encodes each retrieved passage separately and fuses them in the decoder of a seq2seq model (Fusion-in-Decoder).

papers.title: Improving language models by retrieving from trillions of tokens
papers.description: Conditions an autoregressive language model on chunks retrieved from a very large database via chunked cross-attention (RETRO).

papers.title: Atlas: Few-shot Learning with Retrieval Augmented Language Models
papers.description: A retrieval-augmented language model that jointly trains retriever and reader and performs well in few-shot settings.

papers.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
papers.description: Prompts language models to interleave reasoning traces with actions such as search queries.

papers.title: Precise Zero-Shot Dense Retrieval without Relevance Labels
papers.description: Generates a hypothetical answer document with an instruction-following LLM and retrieves real documents similar to it (HyDE).

papers.title: In-Context Retrieval-Augmented Language Models
papers.description: Prepends retrieved documents to the input of an unmodified language model and studies how much this helps.

papers.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
papers.description: Teaches a language model, in a self-supervised way, when and how to call external tools such as search and calculators.

papers.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
papers.description: Finds that language models use information at the start or end of long contexts more reliably than information in the middle.

papers.title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
papers.description: Trains a model to decide when to retrieve and to critique its own generations with special reflection tokens.

papers.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: A Survey
papers.description: Surveys retrieval-augmented generation for LLMs, organising methods into naive, advanced and modular RAG.

papers.title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
papers.description: Builds an LLM-extracted entity graph, summarises its communities (via Leiden) and answers global questions by combining community summaries.

papers.title: Translating Embeddings for Modeling Multi-relational Data
papers.description: Models relations as translations between entity embeddings (h + r ≈ t) for knowledge-base completion.

papers.title: Embedding Entities and Relations for Learning and Inference in Knowledge Bases
papers.description: Presents a general framework for relation embedding and a simple bilinear-diagonal model (DistMult).

papers.title: Complex Embeddings for Simple Link Prediction
papers.description: Uses complex-valued embeddings so a bilinear model can represent antisymmetric relations (ComplEx).

papers.title: Modeling Relational Data with Graph Convolutional Networks
papers.description: Extends graph convolutional networks with relation-specific weights for multi-relational knowledge graphs (R-GCN).

papers.title: Convolutional 2D Knowledge Graph Embeddings
papers.description: Scores knowledge-graph triples with 2D convolutions over reshaped entity and relation embeddings (ConvE).

papers.title: RotatE: Knowledge Graph Embedding by Relational Rotation in Complex Space
papers.description: Models each relation as a rotation in complex space, capturing symmetry, inversion and composition patterns.

papers.title: ERNIE: Enhanced Language Representation with Informative Entities
papers.description: Injects knowledge-graph entity embeddings into BERT-style pretraining.

papers.title: KG-BERT: BERT for Knowledge Graph Completion
papers.description: Treats knowledge-graph triples as text sequences and fine-tunes BERT to score them.

papers.title: K-BERT: Enabling Language Representation with Knowledge Graph
papers.description: Injects knowledge-graph triples into input sentences as a tree and controls their influence with a visibility matrix.

papers.title: KGAT: Knowledge Graph Attention Network for Recommendation
papers.description: Propagates embeddings over a graph that joins user-item interactions with a knowledge graph, using attention to weight neighbours.

papers.title: QA-GNN: Reasoning with Language Models and Knowledge Graphs for Question Answering
papers.description: Scores knowledge-graph nodes with a language model and reasons jointly over the question and the subgraph with a GNN.

papers.title: Unifying Large Language Models and Knowledge Graphs: A Roadmap
papers.description: Surveys and organises work on combining LLMs and knowledge graphs into KG-enhanced LLMs, LLM-augmented KGs and synergised approaches.

papers.title: Think-on-Graph: Deep and Responsible Reasoning of Large Language Model on Knowledge Graph
papers.description: Lets an LLM iteratively explore a knowledge graph with beam search to find reasoning paths for answering questions.

papers.title: DeepWalk: Online Learning of Social Representations
papers.description: Learns node embeddings by treating truncated random walks as sentences for a skip-gram model.

papers.title: LINE: Large-scale Information Network Embedding
papers.description: Embeds large networks by preserving first- and second-order proximity with an edge-sampling objective.

papers.title: node2vec: Scalable Feature Learning for Networks
papers.description: Uses biased second-order random walks that interpolate between BFS- and DFS-like exploration to learn node embeddings.

papers.title: Convolutional Neural Networks on Graphs with Fast Localized Spectral Filtering
papers.description: Defines localized spectral graph convolutions with Chebyshev polynomial filters (ChebNet).

papers.title: Semi-Supervised Classification with Graph Convolutional Networks
papers.description: Simplifies spectral graph convolutions to a first-order, layer-wise propagation rule for semi-supervised node classification (GCN).

papers.title: Neural Message Passing for Quantum Chemistry
papers.description: Unifies several graph neural networks under a message-passing framework and applies it to molecular property prediction.

papers.title: Inductive Representation Learning on Large Graphs
papers.description: Learns aggregation functions over sampled neighbourhoods so embeddings can be generated for unseen nodes (GraphSAGE).

papers.title: Graph Attention Networks
papers.description: Uses masked self-attention over neighbours to weight messages in graph neural networks (GAT).

papers.title: Relational inductive biases, deep learning, and graph networks
papers.description: Argues for relational inductive biases and presents the graph network framework generalising many GNN variants.

papers.title: Graph Convolutional Neural Networks for Web-Scale Recommender Systems
papers.description: Scales graph convolutional networks to billions of nodes for recommendation at Pinterest (PinSage).

papers.title: How Powerful are Graph Neural Networks?
papers.description: Analyses GNN expressiveness relative to the Weisfeiler-Lehman test and proposes the Graph Isomorphism Network (GIN).

papers.title: Graph Neural Networks: A Review of Methods and Applications
papers.description: Reviews GNN architectures, training methods and applications.

papers.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Neural Networks
papers.description: Surveys GNNs with a taxonomy of recurrent, convolutional, autoencoder and spatial-temporal GNNs.

papers.title: Heterogeneous Graph Attention Network
papers.description: Applies node-level and semantic-level attention over meta-path-based neighbours in heterogeneous graphs (HAN).

papers.title: EvolveGCN: Evolving Graph Convolutional Networks for Dynamic Graphs
papers.description: Evolves GCN weights over time with a recurrent network to model dynamic graphs.

papers.title: LightGCN: Simplifying and Powering Graph Convolution Network for Recommendation
papers.description: Removes feature transformation and non-linearity from GCN-based collaborative filtering, keeping only neighbourhood aggregation.

papers.title: Heterogeneous Graph Transformer
papers.description: Uses node- and edge-type-dependent attention to model heterogeneous graphs at web scale (HGT).

papers.title: Inductive Representation Learning on Temporal Graphs
papers.description: Combines self-attention with a functional time encoding for inductive learning on continuous-time temporal graphs (TGAT).

papers.title: Temporal Graph Networks for Deep Learning on Dynamic Graphs
papers.description: A framework for continuous-time dynamic graphs that combines per-node memory with graph-based embedding modules (TGN).

papers.title: Do Transformers Really Perform Bad for Graph Representation?
papers.description: Adds centrality, spatial and edge encodings to a standard Transformer for graph-level prediction (Graphormer).

papers.title: Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks for Malicious Account Detection
papers.description: Detects malicious accounts with a heterogeneous GNN over account-device graphs (GEM).

papers.title: Spam Review Detection with Graph Convolutional Networks
papers.description: Applies graph convolutional networks over a review graph and a comment graph to detect spam reviews (GAS).

papers.title: Anti-Money Laundering in Bitcoin: Experimenting with Graph Convolutional Networks for Financial Forensics
papers.description: Releases the Elliptic Bitcoin transaction graph and compares GCNs with other models for illicit-transaction classification.

papers.title: Alleviating the Inconsistency Problem of Applying Graph Neural Network to Fraud Detection
papers.description: Identifies context, feature and relation inconsistency in fraud graphs and proposes GraphConsis to mitigate them.

papers.title: Enhancing Graph Neural Network-based Fraud Detectors against Camouflaged Fraudsters
papers.description: Counters fraudster camouflage with a label-aware similarity measure and reinforcement-learned neighbour filtering (CARE-GNN).

papers.title: A Comprehensive Survey on Graph Anomaly Detection with Deep Learning
papers.description: Surveys deep-learning methods for detecting anomalous nodes, edges, subgraphs and graphs.

papers.title: Rethinking Graph Neural Networks for Anomaly Detection
papers.description: Observes a 'right-shift' of spectral energy caused by anomalies and proposes band-pass beta-wavelet filters (BWGNN).

papers.title: DGraph: A Large-Scale Financial Dataset for Graph Anomaly Detection
papers.description: Releases a large real-world dynamic financial graph for graph anomaly detection benchmarks.

papers.title: S2ORC: The Semantic Scholar Open Research Corpus
papers.description: Releases a large corpus of English academic papers with metadata, full text and resolved citation links.

papers.title: SPECTER: Document-level Representation Learning using Citation-informed Transformers
papers.description: Learns paper-level embeddings by fine-tuning SciBERT with a triplet loss derived from the citation graph.

papers.title: OpenAlex: A fully-open index of scholarly works, authors, venues, institutions, and concepts
papers.description: Describes OpenAlex, an open catalogue of scholarly works, authors, venues, institutions and concepts.
